### 🎖️ The blocky throwback look — now everywhere
- The whole player roster is back to the game's original **blocky, stack-of-cubes** character, kitted out in woodland camo with an expressive animated face (blinks, glances, talks and emotes for cutscenes) and a proper box female face.
- **Your own hands are the character's hands.** Every first-person view — every gun, the bow, the flamethrower, the shield, melee tools, plus consumables, grenades and deployables — now shows the same blocky arms everyone else sees you with, so what you hold and how you hold it can never drift from your third-person model.

### 🎬 The sixth test
- Starting a new survival world now opens with a scene: four days after the bite, strapped to a gurney, still talking — and a sister with a plan for the gate.
- It plays once per world. A new game plays it again; continuing one you already started does not.
- Skippable at any point with the on-screen button.

### 🏥 Medical & lab props
- Five new props for the map and structure editors, under a new Medical & Lab category: a hospital gurney, a drip stand, a vitals monitor, a supply trolley and a wall cabinet.
- Shots pass between the gurney's side rails instead of stopping on thin air.

### 👀 Faces that are alive
- Characters in a scene blink, and their jaws move while they speak.
